generation.scope: For a center-finite standard regular window on any component, the affine center divisor class group is finite of exponent dividing sixteen times the vertex index; its index multiple is a subquotient of Z/2 x Z/2 x Z/16. The projective center is Q-factorial of rational divisor rank one. A nonmonic quadric center over a smooth quadric cannot have a smooth pole divisor, by Brauer residues.

open_mathematics: Use the residue constraints and low-degree del Pezzo lattices to decide the exceptional center types, and continue the other regularity branches.
